title: Fellows-to-Faculty - 2027 Request for Applications
about: Simons Foundation Fellows-to-Faculty 2027 request for applications, for Ph.D./M.D. scientists in mentored training who will seek tenure-track faculty positions in the upcoming job cycle. Applications via the Simons Award Manager close 13 January 2027 at noon Eastern; awards start 1 September 2027.
requirements: Ph.D. and/or M.D. scientists in mentored research training positions who will seek tenure-track research faculty positions during the upcoming academic job cycle

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: 'Ph.D. and/or M.D. scientists in mentored research training positions' → objective 'Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis.'

'will seek tenure-track research faculty positions' → objective 'Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management.'
